The '''capture of the ''Zeplin''''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

==Prelude==
In the aftermath of the [[Second battle of Imperial Center|ambush]] on [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[C-3 passenger liner]], the ''[[Excalibur]]'', en route to Endor, the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Zeplin]]'', commanded by [[Namuura Din]], escaped during the battle. Due to information from a loyalist Imperial agent planted aboard the ''Zeplin'', Din as well as the ''Zeplin'' were considered high-priority targets, as not only did they have a stolen [[Missile Boat]] and were planning to supply it to the Rebel Alliance as part of a defection, but also Din was rumored to have knowledge about the true state of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] operative status, which would ruin the Emperor's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] should it be revealed. As such, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] in his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] was sent to stop the ''Zeplin'', the [[Imperial Ace]] and Emperor's Hand [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was deployed with him personally leading [[Tau Squadron]] while [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] [[Mu Squadron]] attacked the vessel.

==The battle==
Upon arriving at the ''Zeplin''{{'s}} location, Stele discovered that an [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]], the ''[[Link]]'', was already there and the meeting had already started. Stele quickly inspected the ''Link'' to discover that a stolen Missile Boat was in the cruiser. Soon a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] [[Z-Epsilon 1]] carrying [[Officer/Legends|officers]] launched from the ''Link'' as it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Stele destroyed the transport and made short work of the modified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. Soon the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] engaged the Assault Gunboats, and Stele eliminated them in the process. Stele then launched [[Advanced concussion missile|advanced missiles]] at the ''Zeplin''{{'s}} [[warhead launcher]]s and [[Advanced Proton Torpedo/Legends|advanced torpedos]] until the shields failed, allowing the Gunboats to disable the ''Zeplin''. While dealing with the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] arrived and launched [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] ''[[Omega 1]]'' to board and capture the ''Zeplin''. As the process was underway, Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] entered the area, the A-wings attacking the transport and the B-wings attacking the ''Garrett''. The Rebel attack was destroyed by the ''Garrett''{{'s}} own starfighters and Maarek Stele.

==Aftermath==
The ''Zeplin'' was captured and was to be sent to an Imperial shipyard to be examined by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], and Din detained and interrogated by Darth Vader. The interrogation revealed two primary things; the first was that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] was fully aware of Palpatine's plans at Endor, but only intended to confer to his loyal corps with no sympathies to the Rebels, causing Din to defect. The second, and more important, issue was that the ''Link'' escaped not only with the Missile Boat prototype ''[[Sealion]]'', but with knowledge about the true status of the Death Star II. However, it was eventually cornered and [[Capture of the Link|captured]] by pursuing forces, including the ''Garrett''.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle takes place in the [[1994]] PC game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] as Battle 13 mission 2, "Capture the turncoat." This article assumes both Primary and Secondary goals, and most if not all Bonus goals, are completed.
